field.label: Name
field.help: Unique name for this connection (alphanumeric, max 16 chars). Used as interface suffix: pgw_<name>

field.label: Proxy Server Interface
field.help: Select the OPNsense interface through which the proxy server is reachable. For a Tailscale SOCKS5 proxy on LAN2, select LAN2. This prevents routing loops.

field.label: Server
field.help: Hostname or IP address of the upstream proxy server.

field.label: Port
field.help: Port number of the upstream proxy server.

field.label: Tunnel Address
field.help: Local IPv4 address for the tunnel interface. Leave empty for auto-assignment from the 172.31.0.0/16 range.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Maximum Transmission Unit for the tunnel (1280-9000, default 1500).

field.label: DNS Mode
field.help: How DNS queries should be handled for traffic routed through this gateway.

field.label: Custom DNS Server
field.help: DNS server to use when DNS mode is set to Custom.

field.label: Enable Health Check
field.help: Periodically probe connectivity through this proxy tunnel.

field.label: Interval (seconds)
field.help: How often to run the health check probe (5-3600 seconds).

field.label: Target URL
field.help: URL to probe for health checks. Must return HTTP 200/204.

field.label: Kill Switch
field.help: When enabled, drop all traffic from assigned sources if this tunnel goes down (instead of falling back to WAN).
